resources.string: KoalaCast talks to one server for search, feeds and — if you ever want it — sync. Use ours, or point the app at your own instance.

An account syncs subscriptions, listening progress and settings between your phone and the web. It needs nothing but a username and a password — no email, no phone number. You can also add one later in Settings.
This release build accepts HTTPS servers only.
This build requires HTTPS. HTTP is blocked before any request is sent.
Could not reach that address. Check the spelling, and that the server is running and reachable from this device.
The server answered with status %1$d instead of a health check.
That address answered, but not like a KoalaCast server.
Enter a server address to continue.
No account is created and nothing is uploaded. Your subscriptions, queue and progress stay on this device unless you sign in later. Episode audio always streams straight from the publisher.
